title: Company Access Management — Guide
subtitle: A read-only training walkthrough with sample data and an explanation of every section
demoBanner: Training mode — all data on this page is sample data shown for demonstration only. Nothing is saved or changed here and every control is read-only.

labels.realControlNote: The real control for this section is shown below, in read-only mode.

quickStart.title: What does this page do?
quickStart.intro: The «Company Access Management» page lets an owner/admin decide who can access a company's information:
steps: First a company is selected; until then the access tables are not shown.
In «Access Management» you grant access to people, and in «Role Access» to roles (specific to this company or global).
Each grant sets two levels: «Company Information» and «Access» — each can be «None», «View» or «Edit».
If you only have view access yourself, the page title turns red and the controls are disabled.

selection.title: Select company
selection.intro: The card at the top used to pick the company whose access you want to manage. Until one is selected, the access tables are hidden.
tips: You can only grant access on companies where your own access level is «Edit».

accessManagement.title: Access management (people)
accessManagement.intro: The person-access table. Each person gets two levels: a «Company Information» level and an «Access» level. Each can be «None», «View» or «Edit».
steps: To add, click «Add» and search for and select the person.
Choose the «Company Information» level and the «Access» level from the dropdowns.
Click «Save»; the new row is added to the table.
Use the pencil/trash icons to edit or remove a row.
tips: The «Information» column is the level for viewing/editing the company profile; the «Access» column is the level for managing this access page itself.
If your access is «View», the add/edit/delete buttons are not shown.

roleAccess.title: Role access
roleAccess.intro: The role-access table. You can grant a level to a role (instead of a single person). Each row has a «scope»: «This company» or «Global» (applies to all companies).
steps: To add, click «Add», pick a role and set the «scope» (this company / global).
Choose the «Information» and «Access» levels and click «Save».
Edit/delete from the icons on the same row.
tips: A «Global» scope row affects all companies, not just the current one.
When editing, the row's scope is locked and can't be changed.

items.q: What's the difference between the «Information» and «Access» levels?
items.a: «Information» decides whether the grantee can view/edit the company profile; «Access» decides whether they can view/manage this access-management page itself.

items.q: What's the difference between «person access» and «role access»?
items.a: The first grants access to a specific person; the second to a role (e.g. «Analyst»), covering every user with that role. Roles can also be «global».

items.q: Why don't I see the add/edit buttons?
items.a: Either you haven't selected a company, or your access level on this company is only «View». In view mode the write buttons are hidden.
